note: 'Every item on our menu is gluten free' is verbatim. The 'fermented rice-flour batter' detail is not on Vegewel — it is on life-info.co.jp (「米粉発酵クレープ専門店」「有機米から作るオリジナルの米粉」). Note Vegewel's own attribute list says 'Vegan options on request', which undercuts this record's vegan='full' tier.

quote: A celiac travel writer describes it as 'an excellent 100% gluten free crepe restaurant' and ate two crepes there without noting any issue, treating it as a safe dedicated venue.
found: Waco Crepes is an excellent 100% gluten free crepe restaurant in Kyoto. ... The crepes here were so good that I ordered two! (under the heading '7 Dedicated Gluten Free Kyoto Restaurants')
note: Quote verbatim, ordered-two detail verbatim, and the venue sits under the article's 'Dedicated Gluten Free' heading.

quote: This is a creperie, not a soy-sauce-heavy kitchen, and the shop actually sells bottles of gluten-free soy sauce, indicating awareness of the wheat-in-soy-sauce issue. Savory crepes are gluten-free across the board, but it is still worth confirming with staff that any savory sauce on your specific crepe is the gluten-free version.
found: In Kyoto, you can buy gluten free soy sauce bottles at Waco Crepes.
note: The soy-sauce-bottles fact is verbatim on the cited page; the '100% gluten free' framing for savory items is also on that page.

quote: The whole menu is plant-based, so there is no animal dairy or egg used in the standard dough; the crepe batter itself is naturally vegan and dairy-free cream, cheese and chocolate alternatives are used throughout.
found: 100% Gluten free restaurant with meat, vegan, and vegetarian options (venue's own TripAdvisor blurb) / reviews: 'We had savoury crepes - smoked salmon with cream cheese and ham & cheese.' / 'I had guacamole and cheese for the savory one and whipped cream and strawberries for my sweet one.'
note: ALARMING: the cited page CONTRADICTS the claim. Waco Crepes serves meat and dairy — salmon, ham, cream cheese — and describes itself as offering 'meat, vegan, and vegetarian options'. life-info.co.jp says the same in reverse: only the BATTER is 100％プラントベース, while 「具材は…チーズやバター、チョコレート含めヴィーガン対応可能」 means vegan versions of cheese/butter/chocolate are available ON REQUEST. This record's vegan tier of 'full' is wrong and should be downgraded to options/on-request; 'alternatives are used throughout' must go.

quote: Reviewers across platforms consistently describe the staff as kind, helpful and attentive to allergies and dietary needs.
note: The Vegewel listing carries NO reviews at all — it still shows the 'Please tell us if you'd recommend this restaurant' prompt. The claim is nevertheless true and evidenced on TripAdvisor: 'The staff were kind and friendly and reassuring about gluten free dietary requirements', 'Friendly and very helpful staff. Highly recommend!!', 'Lovely friendly service.'

quote: A fully dedicated gluten-free and vegan kitchen using a fermented organic rice-flour batter, which removes wheat from the premises entirely.
found: 米粉発酵クレープ専門店。看板のクレープには有機米から作るオリジナルの米粉を使用。…100％プラントベース＆グルテンフリーの生地… [batter half supported] / 具材は体にいいものだけ使用し、チーズやバター、チョコレート含めヴィーガン対応可能。 [contradicts 'fully vegan kitchen']
note: The fermented organic rice-flour batter is verbatim and the batter is 100% plant-based — but the same page says cheese, butter and chocolate fillings can be MADE vegan on request, i.e. dairy is in the shop by default. 'Fully dedicated ... vegan kitchen' is contradicted by the cited source. Rewrite as 'dedicated gluten-free; vegan on request'.

quote: Celiac travelers single it out as one of the safer, dedicated gluten-free stops in Kyoto.
found: 7 Dedicated Gluten Free Kyoto Restaurants — Waco Crepes — Waco Crepes is an excellent 100% gluten free crepe restaurant in Kyoto.
note: It is the first entry in a celiac blogger's dedicated-GF list; TripAdvisor corroborates ('This little shop is an absolute gem for anyone that is celiac or gluten (or wheat) intolerant').

quote: Vegan diners praise the abundant plant-based options, including the homemade soy-milk whipped cream and vegan cheese.
found: Small place that offers many vegan options too. / They also have vegan and vegetarian options. (the only cheese mentions on TripAdvisor are dairy: 'cream cheese', 'ham & cheese', 'guacamole and cheese')
note: 'Vegan options' is supported; the specific soy whipped cream and vegan cheese are not on TripAdvisor. life-info.co.jp has them: 「豆腐から手作りするSoy ホイップクリーム」 and 「チーズやバター、チョコレート含めヴィーガン対応可能」 (Vegewel also lists 'soy whipped cream & vegan chocolate'). Note this is a shop offering, not diner praise.

The gluten-free side is excellent and well cited (100% GF, organic rice-flour fermented batter, sells GF soy sauce). The VEGAN side is wrong: the record carries vegan='full' and says plant-based alternatives are 'used throughout', but the cited TripAdvisor page advertises 'meat, vegan, and vegetarian options' and its reviews describe smoked salmon, ham and cream cheese crepes, while life-info.co.jp says vegan cheese/butter/chocolate are available on request. Downgrade the vegan tier before anything else.

quote: 全商品を米粉100％で製造し、小麦粉・白砂糖は一切使用していない（Made with 100% rice flour; no wheat flour or white sugar used at all).
found: 「Okomeya Cafe」さんの"米粉シフォンケーキ"は、小麦粉・白砂糖を一切使用せず、米粉100%で作っているので、小麦粉・白砂糖アレルギーの方でも、安心して食べれます。／市販の米粉パンでも、実際は小麦粉を使用している場合が多いそうですが、「Okomeya Cafe」さんの"米粉100％米粉食パン"は、本当に米粉100％なので、小麦粉アレルギーの方でも安心して食べれます。
note: Verbatim — but the page states it of the 米粉シフォンケーキ and the 米粉100％米粉食パン specifically, not of 全商品 as a blanket. Narrow the record's wording to those product lines; the page is otherwise unusually explicit that this shop's rice bread really is 100% rice, unlike much commercial 米粉パン.

quote: It is a rice merchant / rice mill and food shop (自家精米), not a certified dedicated gluten-free kitchen — the product line is entirely rice-based and the shop sells no wheat products, but celiacs should confirm on the day that no wheat is handled or stored on-site.
found: 京都市南区で創業し99年。一等米にこだわる品揃えが自慢の地域密着型の米穀店に、グルテンフリーのカフェを併設。／廣瀬米穀店は、昭和元年（1926）に精米所として創業。／100％米粉で作るオリジナルのシフォンケーキは、一定の割合の小麦や添加物なども一才含まない真のグルテンフリーのケーキ…
note: The rice-merchant / in-house-milling identity and the gluten-free cafe attached to it are confirmed in detail. The record's honest hedge (no certification, confirm on the day) matches what the source does and does not say.

quote: お米パン／こめやパンは米・米油・メープル・塩・米種・酵母・お湯のみで焼く植物性の食品（rice bread is plant-based). シフォンケーキには卵が含まれる（chiffon contains egg).
found: シンプルな材料＝米・米油・メープル・塩・米種・酵母・お湯だけで焼くグルテンフリーお米食パン。[bread half verbatim] — but Makuake never mentions egg or the chiffon's ingredients.
note: Bread ingredient list is verbatim on Makuake. For the egg statement use the note.com interview, where the owner says 「卵や牛乳、豆乳なども使用する焼き菓子を作る場合、米粉はとてもマッチする」 — i.e. the baked sweets do use egg and milk. Vegans need that sentence sourced properly.

quote: 店主は米粉マイスター・五ツ星お米マイスターの有資格者で、グルテンフリーを明確に掲げている（Owner is a certified rice-flour master and explicitly markets the shop as gluten-free).
found: 2022年 8月 04日 — 【京都】米粉カフェ(米粉マイスターのお店) (a date-archive index page; the shop is never named and no certification is attributed to anyone)
note: The komekomeister URL is a dated blog-archive listing, not an article about this shop — it carries only a headline. Real support: okomeyacafe.com states 「五ツ星お米マイスターProf．と三ツ星お米マイスターが作る【グルテンフリー米屋のお米パン】」 and 「五ツ星お米マイスター認定店」, and Makuake states 「米粉マイスター協会認定米粉マイスター・米粉パンマイスター…の資格取得」. Note the two certifications belong to different people (the rice shop is the 五ツ星お米マイスター; 廣瀬弘香 is the 米粉マイスター) — do not merge them into one 店主.

quote: 米屋なので小麦製品を扱わず、カフェのお菓子・パンはすべて米粉100％（A rice shop that handles no wheat products; all café sweets and bread are 100% rice flour).
found: 米屋にこだわり、米の販売とグルテンフリー商品の製造・販売をしています／【グルテンフリー米屋のお米パン】／(every product block on the home page is tagged グルテンフリー)
http: 200 (Wix site; the home page renders enough text without the JSON fallback)
note: Rice-shop identity and gluten-free product line are on the page. Two accuracy nits: the site never states in words that it handles no wheat products, and the signature お米パン is made from whole milled RICE and 米種, not 米粉 — the owner draws that distinction explicitly in the note.com interview — so 「すべて米粉100％」 is the wrong description for the bread.

quote: 自家精米したての新鮮な米から作るグルテンフリーのお米パンとシフォンケーキ（Gluten-free rice bread and chiffon made from freshly in-house-milled rice).
found: お米屋さんが作る本格的なグルテンフリーメニュー／こちらでは米粉シフォンと米粉ラスクがメインメニューで、毎週水曜日には米粉パンも焼かれています。 [GF chiffon + weekly bread supported; 自家精米 is not mentioned]
note: The distinctive part of the claim — freshly self-milled rice — is not on the ローカログ page. Makuake states it directly: 「廣瀬米穀店の自家精米したての米と米種を使用！」, as does okomeyacafe.com (「お米マイスターお勧め米を自家精米しております」).

Every claim is true and every source is a real, on-topic page; three claims just point at pages that carry only part of them. Worst offender is the komekomeister.com URL, which is a bare date-archive index and evidences nothing. Also narrow 全商品を米粉100％ to the products the sources actually cover, and stop calling the お米パン a 米粉 product.

quote: 焼き菓子の製造ラインは自家製粉の米粉のみで小麦粉を使用しない専門工房のため、製品自体の小麦クロスコンタミ・リスクは低い。
found: 農家から仕入れたお米をお店で製粉し、挽きたてフレッシュな米粉を使ってつくる特別な「バウムクーヘン」は、お米を使ったグルテンフリーのバウムクーヘンです。 [self-milled rice flour + gluten-free product confirmed; nothing about the production line being wheat-free]
method: plain fetch of the press release, then of the shop's own product pages
note: The press release supports 'gluten-free baumkuchen from self-milled rice flour' but NOT the premises-level claim that the workshop uses no wheat flour. The best first-party evidence is the product page's statutory ingredient list — 原材料: 鶏卵、砂糖、バター、食用植物油脂、米粉デンプン、米粉、生クリーム…／特定原材料：卵・乳 — which declares only egg and dairy, no 小麦, under Japan's allergen labelling rules. The only explicit 'wheat-free shop' statement anywhere is the personal blog magewappablog.com. Keep this at product level.

quote: 個人ブログでは『メニューはすべて米粉を使ったグルテンフリー』と報告されているが、店奥のイートインで供する飲み物・付け合わせに小麦品がないかは公式には未確認。
found: 小麦を使わない「グルテンフリー」の洋菓子屋「IKARIYA BEIKA KYOTO」。／お店の人気商品バウムクーヘンのほか、メニューはすべて米粉を使ったグルテンフリーですが…／奥には少しだけイートインスペースもあります。
note: The quoted sentence is verbatim, the source really is a personal blog as the record says, and the eat-in space at the back is confirmed on the same page. Exemplary honest citing.

quote: バウムクーヘンは卵・乳(バター)を含むため、ヴィーガン品との交差接触管理に関する情報はなく、そもそもヴィーガン提供品が確認できない。
found: (the site root is a product-tile page with prices only — no ingredients anywhere on it)
method: plain fetch of the root, then followed the site's own /products/baum/ links
note: Claim is correct — just cite the product page, which spells it out: 「原材料: 鶏卵、砂糖、バター、食用植物油脂、米粉デンプン、米粉、生クリーム…／特定原材料：卵・乳」. Egg, butter and fresh cream confirm no vegan option exists.

quote: 米菓職人が自家製粉した米粉で丁寧に焼き上げると明記されるが、個別の小麦アレルギー対応プロトコルの記載は見当たらない。
found: 自家製粉米粉で米菓職人たちが丁寧に焼上げる京町家ライスバウム／【自家製粉の米粉を使ったバウムクーヘン専門店】
http: 200 (desktop host answered with an iPhone UA; no s.tabelog.com fallback needed)
note: The 米菓職人 / 自家製粉 wording is verbatim, and the record is right that the listing carries no allergy-handling protocol.

quote: 専門店として全焼き菓子が米粉ベースの小麦不使用で、グルテンフリーの土産・スイーツとして京都のGFガイドでも紹介されている。
found: 【2025年最新版】京都で買えるグルテンフリーお土産まとめ — 【烏丸御池駅 徒歩6分】IKARIYA BEIKA KYOTO | 米粉バームクーヘン専門店 ... 米粉バームクーヘンの専門店で…
note: The 'featured in a Kyoto gluten-free souvenir guide' half is exactly what this page is. The guide covers the baumkuchen range specifically, not literally 全焼き菓子, so the blanket 'all baked goods' would be better sourced to magewappablog's 「メニューはすべて米粉」.

quote: 生米を工房内で自家製粉するなど原材料管理にこだわり、JR京都伊勢丹でもグルテンフリーバウムとして販売実績がある。
found: JR京都伊勢丹にて米粉で作ったグルテンフリーのバウムクーヘンを販売開始『IKARIYA BEIKA KYOTO』が2023年3月29日より期間限定で出店／農家から仕入れたお米をお店で製粉し、挽きたてフレッシュな米粉を使ってつくる…お米を使ったグルテンフリーのバウムクーヘンです。／JR京都伊勢丹 B1F洋菓子売場
note: Both halves verbatim. Worth noting the Isetan sale was a limited-period pop-up (29 Mar – 10 Apr 2023), so 'has been sold at' is right but should not read as a standing counter.

The most carefully written record in the shard — it flags its own limits (personal-blog sourcing, no allergy protocol, eat-in drinks unverified) and every claim checks out. Two citations should move to the shop's own product page http://www.ikariya-beika-kyoto.com/products/baum/fuwafuwa/, whose statutory ingredient list (特定原材料：卵・乳, no 小麦) is stronger evidence than either press release.
